title: Stand By Me
hook: The four chords that make Stand By Me *feel safe*

chords.name: F#m
chords.text: Down to *F♯ minor*. A shadow, but the same family.

chords.name: D
chords.text: *D major* lifts it. It's going to be fine.

chords.name: E
chords.text: The V. Its *G♯* aches to get back home.

chords.name: A
chords.text: And it always gets there. *It never lets you down*.
